test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct indirect speech of the sentence:

The general said, "May our nation always remain free."

options.text: The general said our nation may always remain free.
The general expressed the wish that their nation might always remain free.
The general hoped that his nation will remain free.
The general wished the nation would stay free.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Direct Speech:** The general said, "May our nation always remain free."
 
• **Sentence Type:** This is an **Optative Sentence**, which expresses a wish, prayer, or desire.
